tasks.subject: Task 0: Rename widgets/ module → components/
tasks.description:

**Files:** git mv crates/inkapp-core/src/widgets/→components/; modify crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs (mod decl + doc comment); modify crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs (facade re-export); scoped whole-word replace \bwidgets\b→components across crates/*/src,tests + apps/*/src,tests .rs.

tasks.subject: Task 2: CalendarView component (mode-branched render + decode)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** CalendarView<M> whose render+decode both branch on mode. ReadOnly: inert rows, no regions, decodes nothing. Editable: per-event evt-<i> region + cancel affordance, decodes mark → on_cancel(uid). on_cancel is non-capturing fn(&str)->M (value-message).

**Files:** create crates/inkapp-core/src/components/calendar_view.rs; modify components/mod.rs; test crates/inkapp-core/tests/calendar_view.rs.

**Verify:** cargo test -p inkapp-core --test calendar_view → 4 passed

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/components/calendar_view.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/mod.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/calendar_view.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p inkapp-core --test calendar_view", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ReadOnly render no region/affordance", "Editable render region+box per event", "both compile through Typst", "decode: ReadOnly [] / Editable [on_cancel(uid)]"]}
```
